0022600208.text: The Denver Nuggets (5-3, on a two-game winning streak and 9th in the West) visit the Houston Rockets (7-3, 6th in the West, coming off two straight losses) for the Nuggets' 9th game of the season. Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain), while Houston is missing Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain). The Nuggets won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, and their most recent meeting was a 129-93 win in Denver on March 11, 2026.
